channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Early U.K. Election Results Point to Big Losses for Starmer’s Party
item.description: Keir Starmer's Labour Party lost hundreds of council seats in local UK elections. Votes are still being tallied in thousands of local races across Britain, but hundreds of candidates from Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s Labour Party have already lost their council seats.

item.title: SoftBank cuts target for OpenAI margin loan by 40% to $6 billion, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: SoftBank cut its OpenAI margin loan target to $6 billion, a 40% reduction. SoftBank cuts target for OpenAI margin loan by 40% to $6 billion, Bloomberg News reports.

item.title: U.S. lifts hold on immigration applications for doctors, but leaves others waiting
item.description: The US lifted its hold on immigration applications for doctors, leaving others pending. U. S. lifts hold on immigration applications for doctors, but leaves others waiting.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire will hold despite ‘love tap’ strikes
item.description: Trump said the ceasefire will hold despite recent strikes, calling them "love taps". Iran war latest: Trump says ceasefire will hold despite ‘love tap’ strikes The Times.

item.title: Southeast Asia’s leaders confront fallout from Iran war at ASEAN summit
item.description: ASEAN leaders will call for energy cooperation and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Bloc is expected to call for deeper energy cooperation and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Southeast Asia’s leaders confront fallout from Iran war at ASEAN summit.

item.title: Paraguay and Taiwan reaffirm ties after China sought to lure away another Taipei ally
item.description: Paraguay's President Mario Abdo Benítez met with Taiwan's President Tsai Ing-wen in Taipei, reaffirming their diplomatic ties. The meeting comes after China attempted to lure Paraguay away from Taiwan with economic incentives. Paraguay remains one of the few countries to maintain formal relations with Taiwan.

item.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
item.description: Oil prices rose after US and Iranian forces exchanged fire in the Hormuz strait. The incident occurred despite US President Donald Trump's claim that a ceasefire between the two countries remains in place. The exact circumstances of the exchange are unclear.

item.title: Russia's internet crackdown hobbles small businesses
item.description: Russia's internet crackdown has severely impacted small businesses, with many reporting difficulties in accessing online services. The restrictions have been in place since 2019 and have been criticized for stifling innovation and economic growth. Many small businesses have been forced to close or adapt to the new regulations.

item.title: Early U.K. election results bad news for Labour and PM Starmer
item.description: Early election results in the UK show Labour and Prime Minister Starmer trailing behind the Conservative Party. The votes are seen as an unofficial referendum on Starmer's leadership, which he has held for less than two years. The results are a blow to Labour's hopes of regaining power.

item.title: UAE reports drone, missile attack as ceasefire is challenged
item.description: The UAE reported a drone and missile attack on its territory, challenging a ceasefire between Iran and the US. The attack comes after Iran and the US traded fire earlier, with US President Trump dismissing the attacks as "a trifle." The UAE has not specified the source of the attack.

item.title: Indonesian rescuers search for missing hikers after Mount Dukono erupts
item.description: Nine Singaporeans are missing after Mount Dukono erupted. Indonesian rescuers are searching for them. Nine Singaporeans were reported missing. Indonesian rescuers search for missing hikers after Mount Dukono erupts.

item.title: India pushes for inclusive migration, stronger anti-trafficking laws at United Nations General
item.description: India's Kirti Singh pushed for inclusive migration and anti-trafficking laws at the United Nations. Kirti Singh highlighted the various extensive initiatives undertaken by India, including the use of digital technologies, to support its nationals abroad.

item.title: Ceasefire on brink as Tehran launches fresh strikes on UAE
item.description: Trump claimed a ceasefire is still in place despite the US and Iran trading strikes. Iran war live: Trump says ceasefire still in place despite trading strikes in Hormuz The Independent.

item.title: 2 Indians Among Crew On Cruise Ship Hit By Deadly Hantavirus Outbreak
item.description: Two Indians are among 150 passengers and crew on MV Hondius hit by a hantavirus outbreak. The Indians are part of the 150 passengers and crew aboard MV Hondius. 2 Indians Among Crew On Cruise Ship Hit By Deadly Hantavirus Outbreak.

item.title: 2 Indian nationals part of crew of luxury cruise ship that reported hantavirus outbreak
item.description: Two Indian nationals are part of the crew on a luxury cruise ship with a hantavirus outbreak. The luxury cruise ship, operated by Oceanwide Expeditions, began its journey on April 1 from Argentina’s Ushuaia and is expected to arrive in Spain’s Canary Islands on May 10.

item.title: UAE Reports New Strikes As US-Iran Ceasefire Hangs By Thread
item.description: The UAE was hit by a drone and missile attack, challenging a fragile Iran war ceasefire. The attack came as US-Iran tensions escalated in the critical Strait of Hormuz waterway.

item.title: US, Iran trade fire in Hormuz amid ceasefire tensions
item.description: The US and Iran traded fire near Hormuz amid ceasefire tensions, with both sides accusing each other. Iran accuses US of breaching ceasefire near Hormuz as CENTCOM says forces responded to Iranian attacks.

item.title: Doctors get relief from US immigration application curbs, but wait grows for others
item.description: US immigration curbs on doctors have been lifted, but wait times for others have increased. Doctors get relief from US immigration application curbs, but wait grows for others.

item.title: UAE says it responded to incoming attacks after Iran, US trade blows
item.description: The UAE responded to incoming attacks after the US and Iran exchanged blows. UAE says it responded to incoming attacks after Iran, US trade blows Al Jazeera.

item.title: Ex-China Defence Ministers Get Suspended Death Sentences In Corruption Cases
item.description: Two former Chinese defence ministers received suspended death sentences for corruption. The sentences are the latest in Chinese President Xi Jinping's campaign of purging senior officials. Ex-China Defence Ministers Get Suspended Death Sentences In Corruption Cases.
